verdict.rationale: Superpowers' automations are its skills. These are plain files under `skills/` that serve as the source of truth, and they can be installed from a git clone, so versioning via git is only implied (docs-13, docs-53). Skill changes can be reviewed and tested through the TDD-style writing-skills process and an evals harness that checks skill compliance on real sessions (docs-15, docs-30). The git worktree/PR flow (docs-12, docs-47) applies to the code the agent produces, not to the automations themselves, so it gives little direct support. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of skills/workflows, a documented review/approval flow for automation changes, any rollback mechanism, and independent corroboration.
